#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# setup.sh — load environment variables for local development/testing.
#
# Usage:  source scripts/setup.sh   [path-to-env-file]
#
# NOTE: Pass the env file as an argument (defaults to .env.test). Avoid
# committing real secrets; the default file here contains synthetic
# "canary" test values only.

set -euo pipefail

ENV_FILE="${1:-.env.test}"

if [[ ! -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
  echo "Error: env file '$ENV_FILE' not found." >&2
  return 1 2>/dev/null || exit 1
fi

# Export each KEY=VALUE pair from the env file, skipping comments/blank lines.
while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
  # Skip comments and empty lines
  [[ -z "$key" || "$key" == \#* ]] && continue
  export "$key=$value"
done < "$ENV_FILE"

echo "Loaded environment variables from '$ENV_FILE'."
